instruction: Open the Master Slides view through the View menu, click on the slide number text, and apply underline formatting from the formatting toolbar

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: This task requires the agent to navigate to master slides view and apply underline formatting to the slide number placeholder. The evaluator verifies the underline formatting by parsing the slide master XML and checking for the underline attribute (u) in the text run properties.

llm_judge_reasons: Metric correctly identifies slide number placeholder (ph_type='sldNum') in slide master XML
Comprehensive underline attribute checking covers both a:rPr and a:defRPr elements
All valid underline types are checked (sng, dbl, heavy, dotted, etc.)
Proper postconfig saves file with Ctrl+S to persist changes before verification
File extraction using get_vm_file works correctly for PPTX files
Minor issue: Metric searches all a:rPr/a:defRPr within slide number shape, potentially matching underline on non-slide-number text runs within same shape (though unlikely in practice)
Metric parameter named 'rules' instead of standard 'expected', but doesn't affect functionality since parameter is unused
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider more targeted XPath to ensure underline is specifically on the slide number field text, not just anywhere in the sldNum shape
Consider renaming metric parameter from 'rules' to 'expected' for consistency with framework conventions (though not critical since unused)
